svg.title: costa@github: an Omarchy desktop with fastfetch and journalctl
svg.desc: An Omarchy desktop. Clippy walks the bar and says: "It looks like you're writing a commit message. Just put 'fix' like you always do.". cava bounces to the music. fastfetch prints costa@github: OS Omarchy, Host Just Eat Takeaway, Memory too expensive, Swap Kotlin, C#, QML, 34 posts, Alcohol yes, Resolution won't fix. journalctl prints the latest posts (5 stages of (developer) grief; At the mountains of madness: Interviews), 8,321 installs, and the Graveyard's 2,676 slaps and 208 kills.

text.tspan: clippy.service: Main process exited, code=killed, status=SIGSLAP
clippy.service: Scheduled restart job, restart counter is at 208.
